sql: WITH cte AS (SELECT id, name FROM s.t) SELECT * FROM cte WHERE name ~ '^[a-z]'
note: CTE with regex match filter in outer query

sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n < 5) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n SET ord SELECT * FROM r WHERE ord IS NOT NULL
note: SEARCH DEPTH FIRST SET column used in WHERE clause

sql: WITH cte AS (SELECT id, name FROM s.t) SELECT * FROM cte c WHERE c.id IN (WITH src AS (SELECT id FROM s.t LIMIT 3) SELECT id FROM src)
note: WITH in scalar subquery inside outer WHERE

sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n < 5) CYCLE n SET c USING p SELECT n, c, p FROM r
note: CYCLE with short column names c and p

sql: WITH cte AS (SELECT id FROM s.t WHERE id > (WITH sub AS (SELECT min(id) FROM s.t) SELECT * FROM sub)) SELECT * FROM cte
note: WITH in correlated subquery inside CTE body WHERE clause

sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n < 5) SEARCH FIRST BY n SET ord SELECT * FROM r
note: SEARCH without DEPTH or BREADTH keyword (syntax error)
